_comment: Example style guide for the 'Compliance With Style Guide' rubric category. No real Red30 Tech style guide exists in this repo, so these rules are a reasonable placeholder set of common business-writing conventions — edit freely to match your organization's actual guide. banned_terms maps a disallowed word/phrase to its preferred replacement.

banned_terms.leverage: use (when used as a verb, e.g. "leverage our platform")
banned_terms.click here: a descriptive link label (e.g. "see the pricing guide")
